title: RAW_UNSCREENED: conjunctive source-condition guards select signed effects
summary: A finite De balneis operator grammar treats each complete clause as a conjunctive guard over bath identity, water state, recipient, and explicit condition, yielding a signed effect without free body-effect glosses.

design.grammar: CLAUSE = GUARD(SOURCE, STATE?, RECIPIENT?, CONDITION?) -> EFFECT(SIGN, TARGET)
source_clauses_exact: Illa recens in fonte suo sinthomata tollit,
Fonte relicta suo nichil affert utilitatis;
Sed nocet ydropicis, cum sit dulcissima potu:
Culma nocet sanis, morbida membra iuuat.
design.prediction: Joint source, state, recipient, and condition scope must be retained; VII and XXXIII must permit different hydrops signs and XIX must preserve healthy/diseased contrast.
design.nearest_rival: One fixed sign/effect per body family with source and water state treated as decorative context.
design.falsifier: Condition co-occurrence cannot be preserved, or a condition-free body-effect table performs equally well without repairs.
assumption_costs: Only explicitly supplied guard fields are present.
No target word or medical truth is inferred.
design.scope_note: Source-only raw grammar; no target endpoint or test selected.
